operation_static_review.preconditions: Exact inventory target inode, stable metadata, byte hash, regular files, one link, no flags/xattrs/ACLs, same device; rechecked per target. Source/target bytes checked before cloning and before replacement.
operation_static_review.replacement: cp -c creates a unique temporary clone; clone digest verified, target owner/group/mode applied, file fsync, sampled atime/mtime applied; atomic os.replace of target only. Target digest and stable metadata then checked; temporary path cleaned in finally.
operation_static_review.result_tracking: Result created before per-target checks, updated after each verified replacement; complete only after all58. An exception may leave a partial operation requiring inspection, not automatic rollback.
operation_static_review.source_mutation: No source writes or replacement; read calls may affect source atime.
operation_static_review.atime: Per-operation before.lstat sample is taken before the operation's own hash reads. That sampled value is restored after replacement. It is not an inventory/historical-atime or concurrent-access preservation guarantee.
operation_static_review.filesystem_identity: Target inode/ctime/birthtime may change; stable bytes/mode/uid/gid/mtime must match inventory. Directory durability is not independently fsynced. No exclusive filesystem lock or continuous stability claim.
operation_static_review.execution: Only this retained independent static hash/metadata helper executed. Inventory and clone helpers were read and AST-parsed, never imported or executed.
